purpose: Validate bridged QinQ ingress metadata, two-worker support, reactive TCP modes and context-switch snapshots.
method: Functional calibration, not acceptance throughput. Linux6.8 captures200 TAP frames at each point on disjoint CPU sets; the capture sleep and process affect its rate interval. Linux7.0 uses four workers per daemon on eight total CPUs shared with load processes. Cross-kernel rates are not matched. Default-veth mode predates the checksum-off control; all other bridged SEGMENTS1 UDP points disable source TX checksum/GSO and receiving bridge-port GRO. GSO/TCP keep existing offloads. TCP points are paced smoke checks, not unlimited capacity tests. Per-thread context switches cover before/sent for UDP, before/after for TCP. Raw iperf system_info hostname is omitted.
